_schema: Market and product parameters for the oregon-portland pack (preservation-loan-book). Every value carries value, as_of and source. Values marked verify must be re-pulled before a run that depends on them; verified_live false means the publisher's page was not fetched in this build. Statutory day/month counts are stored ONLY here (plb/agency_calendar.py reads them) and are snippet-derived: confirm against current statute text before any letter cites them. Market-rate cap rates, price per unit, asking rents, refinance spreads, bridge terms, rent-cap, relocation, Schedule R, lien-search and OJCIN fees from the buyer-side pack are removed. Read by plb/recap_math.py, plb/agency_calendar.py, plb/units.py, make_handoffs.py and build_board_workbook.py (Assumptions tab).

benchmarks_source.source: sibling skill multifamily-benchmarks; surface this date in the Assumptions tab

cap_rate_affordable.source: derived: Class C cap + 100 bp for as-restricted collateral context inside recap memos only; not a market observation; never on a lead

vacancy.source: Kidder Mathews Portland Multifamily Q2 2026 vacancy (stabilized underwriting input for restricted NOI on non-assisted units)

opex_per_unit_regulated.source: OHCS Affordable Housing Financial Report FY24 $8,198/unit inflated ~3%/yr; low-end bound for older Class C

opex_ratio_affordable.source: convention for regulated portfolio (compliance costs, lower payroll efficiency)

senior_dscr_floor.source: sizing-lihtc-permanent-debt hard-debt convention (1.15x typical; mandatory soft debt vs residual receipts handled there); used by recap_math.recap_gap

dscr_floor_affordable.source: alias of senior_dscr_floor kept for v2 compatibility

debt_yield_floor.source: multifamily-benchmarks: agency debt yield 8-9% (senior sizing context only)

ust10.source: PLACEHOLDER 10-year US Treasury yield for senior-rate framing in recap memos; pull the current value before any run

senior_rate_default.source: PLACEHOLDER: ust10 + ~200 bp for a new first mortgage in the recap gap example; replace with the proposed senior lender's quote

recap_loan_rate.source: agency 0% recapitalization / rehab loan product (zero_pct_rehab_recap in mandate.json); placeholder, no OHCS product sheet read

rehab_loan_rate.source: placeholder soft rehab loan rate; verify agency product terms

preservation_nofa_open.source: OHCS centralized Affordable Rental Housing NOFA cohort runs Feb-May (2025 pattern); see mandate.json ohcs_preservation_nofa application_window

gap_4pct_available.source: OHCS 4% LIHTC with tax-exempt bonds plus gap, rolling (mandate.json lihtc_4pct_gap); verify bond cap status

acquisition_grant_max_per_unit.source: Metro bond / county acquisition program per-unit cap; not retrieved in this build

push_window_prep_months.source: INTERNAL prep date: PUSH_WINDOW_PREP = anchor - 36 mo. No statutory basis found for a 36-month owner-notice start; OAR 813-115-0030 (summary) reads no sooner than 30 and at least 24 months before withdrawal; 36 months is SB 973's TENANT notice outer bound

push_first_notice_months.source: ORS 456.260 / OAR 813-115-0030 (summary): owner notice to OHCS and each affected local government no sooner than 30 months before withdrawal; ORS 456.262 lets OHCS appoint a designee after the owner's notice OR 30 months before expiry, whichever is earlier; the (1)/(2) split is unread (post-SB 973 text not read); PUSH_FIRST_NOTICE_DUE = anchor - 30 mo

push_second_notice_months.source: ORS 456.260 / OAR 813-115-0030 (summary): owner notice at least 24 months before withdrawal; ORS 456.262 bars withdrawal until 24 months after the (2) notices (unread); PUSH_SECOND_NOTICE_DUE = anchor - 24 mo

tenant_notice_months.source: SB 973 (2025): tenant notice not less than 30 and not more than 36 months before restriction expiry, five languages, applicant disclosure (staff summary snippet); TENANT_NOTICE_WINDOW

sb973_operative_restriction_date.source: SB 973 operative 2026-01-01 per staff summary; v2 noted a phase-in for restrictions ending on/after 2028-07-01 that was not confirmed. Anchors before this date get tenant_notice_status n/a_pre_operative. VERIFY against the enrolled bill before relying on it

records_request_after_notice_days.source: internal target: the qualified purchaser's records request follows the owner's notice within 10 days (RECORDS_REQUEST_DUE); not a statutory figure

records_request_response_days.source: OAR 813-115-0050 Qualified Purchaser Access to Property, Records and Documents (implements ORS 456.262(6)-(7); compliance reports, approved rent schedule with actual rents). The 30-day response period was NOT found in any snippet: working target only; read ORS 456.262(6)-(7). RECORDS_RESPONSE_DUE

rofr_match_days.source: ORS 456.263 / OAR 813-115-0070: qualified purchaser has 30 days from the owner's certified mailing of a third-party offer to deliver a matching offer (snippet); ROFR_MATCH_DEADLINE

rofr_duration_months_after_termination.source: ORS 456.262: the qualified purchaser's notice must declare that the right of first refusal expires 24 months after the withdrawal date (statute snippets and the OHCS designee page); no source supports 36

rofr_recordable_days_after_offer.source: ORS 456.262 (snippet): on or after the date OHCS may appoint a designee, a qualified purchaser first delivers an OFFER to purchase that includes notice that it may, after 30 days, record a notice of right of first refusal; ROFR_RECORDABLE_DATE = qp_offer_delivered_date + 30 d

push_program_coverage_verified.source: ORS 456.250 defines publicly supported housing by a HUD / USDA / OHCS rent-assistance or affordability contract plus assistance identified in OAR 813-115-0010 (unread). Until true, HOME-only (PJ) and LIHTC-only rows receive their PuSH window with Verify — PuSH Coverage

qc_response_months.source: IRC 42(h)(6)(I): one-year period for the housing credit agency to present a qualified contract after a complete request; QC_RESPONSE_DUE

qc_tenant_protection_months.source: IRC 42(h)(6)(E)(ii): three years of no-eviction / no-rent-increase after extended-use termination

hap_optout_notice_months.source: 42 U.S.C. 1437f(c)(8); 24 CFR 402.8: one-year owner notice to tenants, HUD and the contract administrator; HAP_OPTOUT_NOTICE_DEADLINE

hap_optout_package_days.source: HUD Section 8 Renewal Policy Guidebook (March 2023) ch. 11: opt-out request and certification not less than 120 days before expiration (secondary summaries); HAP_OPTOUT_PACKAGE_DUE

hap_annual_renewal_roll_months.source: convention: next_expected_expiration = stale date + 12 months for annually renewing contracts (STALE_CONTRACT_DATE rows)

prac_renewal_term_years.source: Notice H 2022-05: 202/811 PRAC renewals on five-year terms (snippet)

inspection_cadence_home.source: 24 CFR 92.504(d)(1): HOME rental on-site inspections every 3 years (1-4 units), 2 years (5-25), annually (26+); months; INSPECTION_DUE

inspection_cadence_lihtc.source: 26 CFR 1.42-5(c)(2): agency inspects at least once every 3 years, 20% of low-income units; months

form_8823_filing_days_after_correction.source: 26 CFR 1.42-5(e): Form 8823 no later than 45 days after the end of the correction period (snippet)

usda_public_body_offer_days.source: 7 CFR 3560.659: offer to nonprofit / public body for 180 days after advertising (snippet); USDA_PUBLIC_BODY_OFFER_WINDOW_END

usda_rd_tenant_notice_days.source: 7 CFR 3560.654: RD notifies tenants within 30 days of a complete prepayment request (snippet)

section_250_notice_days.source: NHA Section 250 / Notice H 2013-25: 236 and 221(d)(3) BMIR prepayment requires at least 150 and not more than 270 days advance notice (summary); verify

nspire_fail_score.source: HUD NSPIRE scoring notice (July 2023): fail below 60; DEC referral <= 30 from the pre-NSPIRE 60points procedure (verify whether re-issued)

upb_at_risk_window_months.source: public_upb_at_risk rule: upb where any owner-cliff PRESSURE event <= 36 months OR covenant_status in {watch, default} OR coterminous_senior_cliff (pipeline-contract Section 5)

coterminous_senior_window_months.source: coterminous_senior_cliff: senior LOAN_MATURITY / HUD_DIRECT / HAP within 24 months of our maturity

sponsor_concentration_upb_share.source: Sponsor_Exposure flag when one organization holds >= 10% of book UPB or >= 3 cliffs in 36 months

book_verdict_thresholds.source: book verdict STABLE / WATCH / STRESSED / CRITICAL from share of book UPB on watch/default and share of book units with an owner cliff <= 24 months; convention

av_is_market.source: Oregon Measure 50: Assessed Value is capped and commonly ~50-55% of market in Multnomah; never use AV for value; this pack carries no value on a lead

multco_recorder_image_fee.source: Multnomah County DART non-certified document copy (LURA / Notice of ROFR images on documents_to_request.csv); snippet

safmr.source: HUD FY2026 Small Area FMRs, Portland-Vancouver-Hillsboro MSA, 2BR examples (gross rents incl. utilities); used only by the optional NOAH watch rent_to_fmr_ratio and by restricted_noi as a floor
